Name: Fast Forward While Sitting
Author: GianStr08
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Makes time and characters faster when you're sitting down (5x default).
- Configurable through Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) or config.json inside the mod's folder
- Should work with all modded npcs (Ridgeside Village and SVE tested)

[size=4][b]Warnings[/b][/size]
- This mod will lag at high speeds (15x,20x) because it updates all characters faster, although it shouldn't crash your game, just run at low fps
- If this is an important matter for you, the mod is entirely vibecoded, although a human made version is on the way (will take some time as I am still learning C# in my spare time)
- Any bugs, you can either post them in the comments, or send me a message at my Discord: gian.stb (faster response)

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Basic mod download procedure:
- Install SMAPI
- Put the mod inside your 'mods' folder
- Run the game
- Sit down

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI is required[/color]
[/size]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional, although recommended
